subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The new policy will have been debated for months before it is implemented.

options.text: They will have debated the new policy for months before it is implemented.
The new policy will have debated for months before they implement it.
The new policy will be debated for months before it is implemented.
They will be debating the new policy for months before they implement it.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. They will have debated the new policy for months before it is implemented .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is originally written in the **passive voice**, where the subject (the new policy) is acted upon.
 
• To convert the sentence into the **active voice**, the subject performing the action must be explicitly stated (they).
 
• The structure of the active voice is **Subject + verb + object**. In this case, the subject is "they," the verb is "will have debated," and the object is "the new policy."

Correct sentence: *They will have debated the new policy for months before it is implemented*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active vs Passive Voice:**
 
 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: She wrote the book.
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject is acted upon. Example: The book was written by her.
 
 
 
• **Usage:** Active voice is preferred for clarity and directness, while passive voice is used when the focus is on the action or when the performer of the action is unknown or unimportant.
